title: The domain paused itself and nobody was told for six days
symptom: The lab journal recorded 'weed PAUSED by stop-loss' and the platform kept looking healthy; the loop had not run a round when the pause was noticed on 2026-09-04.
root_cause: The stop-loss had no notification surface: the sync alarm covers data freshness and nothing covered the scheduler itself, so a correctly-paused domain is indistinguishable from an idle one.
correction_made: brain/scheduler_health.py plus GET /api/health/scheduler and a site-wide banner on the same positive-heartbeat principle as the sync alarm: a missing or stale heartbeat, a paused domain, or failing ledger writes all read crit; the alarm fails closed.
correction_class: code

version_tag: v3.25.0
category: incident
scope: campaign-governance
healthy_control: false
detectable_from: the domain's enabled flag and paused_reason in the scheduler state file; the age of the last ledger round-step transition
artifact_paths_expected: ~/.round_scheduler.json; lab journalctl --user -u weed-dashboard; results/framework/scheduler_status.json
provenance_guess: record-only
provenance_reason: the evidence is a lab-side journal line and the scheduler state file; there is no cluster artifact for a job that was never submitted.
inventory_notes: Distinct from the walltime case: the failure here is the absence of an event, which no bundle built from job artifacts can contain. It is the argument for the alarm arm (A0++).
